statement: In all 7 analysed books at least one spread carries story information only in the picture (who caused the mess, what is hiding, who is now left out); one book is wordless.

scope.population: contemporary open-licence picture books (Book Dash, South Africa, 2021-2025)

analyst_note: 2026-10-14: Best Friends and An Unexpected Adventure (wordless) reviewed for this claim. Best Friends shows only in the picture that the new friend now sits alone; the wordless book counts trivially and should not be weighed as independent evidence of the technique.

magicpaper.suggested: Hypothesis for illustrated stories: leave one fact per story to the picture; not applicable to text-only stories.
